subject.title: Feature Request: WhatsApp sticker send support

question: Which public WhatsApp sticker-send contract and encoding policy should OpenClaw support before implementation?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the choice between a sticker action, a send option, WebP heuristics, and sticker re-encoding affects user-facing behavior and compatibility.

options.title: Use Explicit Sticker Intent
options.body: Expose `action=sticker` or a WhatsApp send option and send sticker payloads only when that intent is present.

options.title: Use WebP Heuristics
options.body: Automatically route qualifying WebP media as stickers, accepting ordinary WebP image misclassification and encoding edge-case risk.

options.title: Defer Until Cross-Channel Contract
options.body: Keep the low-level helper and wait for a broader channel sticker contract before exposing WhatsApp sticker sends.

recommendation.title: Use Explicit Sticker Intent
recommendation.body: Expose `action=sticker` or a WhatsApp send option and send sticker payloads only when that intent is present.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr added the structured `sendSticker` helper and QA driver path that most directly overlaps the remaining public-contract decision.
